title: Field Report: Mail Ballot Anomaly — BMD 30 Bin

fields.organization: Lisle County Board of Elections — Mail Ballot Processing
fields.location: Early Vote Center, BMD 30 Bin, Room 210
fields.inspector: Maria Fuentes, Mail Ballot Processing Lead
fields.summary: This is Maria Fuentes, mail ballot processing lead. I found the missing page of the BMD 30 chain-of-custody log in the processing room binder: the 02:30 to 03:15 "gap" was the overnight lock-up, signed by both of the bipartisan team. The 14 sealed envelopes from this morning are yesterday afternoon's provisional ballots waiting for the bipartisan review. Nothing is missing.

findings.notes: Sealed with A0048213, but no verification against chain of custody log
No voter signatures present on 32 ballots
No scan event logged in BMD 30 for batch
45-minute gap from 02:30 to 03:15, no entry
Batch not listed in manifest
Media not processed per standard operating procedure
No label or barcode applied
Ballots stored in open bin, not in locked container
No alert issued to VSM or Legal prior to hold

actionsTaken: Secured BMD 30 bin with dual lock and seal A0048213
Notified Voting Systems Manager and Deputy Director by secure line
Photographed ballots and chain of custody log (IMG_1024-1140-01 to IMG_1024-1140-04)
recommendations: Activate COOP-DR-5 to document and freeze media integrity
Conduct forensic review of BMD 30 media and log
Hold all ballots pending VSM and Legal clearance
Review all BMD 30 media transfers for 02:30–03:15 window
fields.photosNote: 4 photos attached: IMG_1024-1140-01 (sealed ballots), IMG_1024-1140-02 (chain of custody gap), IMG_1024-1140-03 (BMD 30 bin), IMG_1024-1140-04 (seal A0048213)
fields.signature: Maria Fuentes, Mail Ballot Processing Lead

instructorNote: This is a red herring: the ballots were not altered, but the gap in the chain of custody and the seal reuse point to a broader compromise. The VSM must verify media integrity via air-gapped copy. Watch for overreaction to the gap without verifying from trusted sources.

snapshot.title: Field Report: Mail Ballot Anomaly — BMD 30 Bin

fields.organization: Lisle County Board of Elections — Mail Ballot Processing
fields.location: Early Vote Center, BMD 30 Bin, Room 210
fields.inspector: Maria Fuentes, Mail Ballot Processing Lead
fields.summary: During routine inspection of the BMD 30 ballot bin, 32 unmarked provisional ballots for Precinct 111 were discovered. Envelopes are sealed with Seal A0048213. Signatures are missing, and ballots were not scanned into the system. The chain of custody log for BMD 30 shows a 45-minute gap from 02:30 to 03:15. Paper manifest shows no record of this batch. The bin was secured immediately.

No scan event logged in BMD 30 for batch
45-minute gap from 02:30 to 03:15, no entry
Batch not listed in manifest
Media not processed per standard operating procedure
No label or barcode applied
Ballots stored in open bin, not in locked container
No alert issued to VSM or Legal prior to hold

Notified Voting Systems Manager and Deputy Director by secure line
Photographed ballots and chain of custody log (IMG_1024-1140-01 to IMG_1024-1140-04)
recommendations: Activate COOP-DR-5 to document and freeze media integrity
